top_issues.issue: The bottom scroll fade is painted over a real result preview, making text fail WCAG 2.2 AA.
top_issues.evidence: Pillow samples in Dorothy Vaughan's preview: light (415,588) #87898e on #ffffff = 3.50:1; dark (419,588) #84878e on #25272b = 4.16:1. Even the darkest/lightest glyph pixels on row 587 reach only 3.69:1 light and 4.28:1 dark. Body text requires 4.5:1.
top_issues.fix: Keep the whole final visible result above the fade; clip partial rows cleanly or apply the fade only to empty padding. Use #62656d on white and #9c9ea8 on #26272c for full-opacity secondary text.

top_issues.issue: The narrow layout preserves too much navigation width and loses useful conversation or contact information.
top_issues.evidence: At 760x640 the main pane starts at x296, leaving 464 pixels. Contact name begins near x128 and date near x244; Katherine Johnson and Margaret Hamilton truncate. Channel content has further card/avatar indents.
top_issues.fix: At widths below 800 points, offer a 200-point navigation pane including the rail, or collapse the list behind a back control. Put dates on the preview line to preserve name width.

top_issues.issue: The narrow calls list loses the visible video-call action.
top_issues.evidence: At 1280 pixels, each recent-person row has phone near x295 and video near x333. At 760 pixels, only phone near x267 remains; no visible overflow control replaces video.
top_issues.fix: Keep both 24-point action targets by moving them into a second row, or expose a 24-point overflow button with both call choices.

top_issues.issue: Too much useful information uses the smallest text tiers.
top_issues.evidence: Timestamp glyphs are roughly 9-10 pixels tall, rail labels roughly 8-9 pixels, and many section labels roughly 8 pixels. Main message glyphs are roughly 13-14 pixels tall. Composer hint is a separate small line across almost every transcript.
top_issues.fix: Use 13-point secondary text with an 18-point line height for timestamps, result emails and useful hints. Reserve 11 points for nonessential badges. Use 12-point medium-weight section labels.

top_issues.issue: Extreme-aspect attachment previews are too small to inspect.
top_issues.evidence: Three boxes are about 144x96 pixels at x407,559,711 and y599. The 3072x256 image fits into about 144x12 pixels; the 256x3072 image becomes about 8x94 pixels.
top_issues.fix: Retain the full-image fit view, but provide a clearly visible 24-point inspect button and a crop/zoom preview on activation. Show a filename or attachment ordinal at 13 points alongside dimensions.

top_issues.issue: Quoted lists lose their structure and become dense miniature paragraphs.
top_issues.evidence: The quoted three-item list becomes inline bullet-separated text in a roughly 543x59-pixel block at standard width and a roughly 365x75-pixel block at narrow width. The original list has distinct lines and more vertical rhythm.
top_issues.fix: Preserve list line breaks in quotes, use 13-point text with 18-point leading, and show two lines plus an expand control when a compact quote is needed.

top_issues.issue: The calls page gives explanatory prose more visual space than the actual call choices.
top_issues.evidence: In the narrow main pane, How calls work begins at y201 and its explanation/capability content extends to y405. The meeting form occupies y78-174, while recent-person actions remain tiny outline icons.
top_issues.fix: Keep the visible explanation to one 13-point sentence, put the full capability list under Details, and use 24-point phone/video icons with 32-point targets in recent-person rows.

top_issues.issue: Settings mixes control widths and vertical rhythms in a tall scrolling surface.
top_issues.evidence: Dialog spans x359-920 and y49-722. Select fields span x384-684, while checkbox rows and descriptions run close to x882; the scrollbar sits at x894. The last visible row sits just above the bottom fade.
top_issues.fix: Use a common 24-point inset and a consistent 16-point section gap. Align selects to a shared content grid, and keep a 48-point footer with a visible Done button outside the scroll area.

top_issues.evidence: Client-ID label appears around y357 and field y373. Tenant label is around y437, helper at y459-478 and field y490. The helper pushes the input far away from its label.
top_issues.fix: Place each label 8 points above its field, put helper copy 6 points below the field, and use 24 points between field groups. Keep at least 32 points below the footer at 800-point height.

top_issues.issue: Meeting system events consume excessive transcript height.
top_issues.evidence: In the 720x800 docked screen the header ends at y132, beginning-of-conversation text appears near y307, first message near y420, and subsequent system events occupy y598-670. The 380-pixel panel also spreads lifecycle entries across several separate rows.
top_issues.fix: Use 12-16-point spacing around compact event rows and reduce the empty lead-in above the first divider to 32 points. Group meeting start/end information where possible.

top_issues.issue: A long draft has weak orientation feedback.
top_issues.evidence: The composer occupies y552-760 and shows only column_111 through column_119. A narrow scroll thumb near x1167,y713-751 is its only visible position cue.
top_issues.fix: Add a quiet 12-point line-count/position label above the action row, such as Lines 111-119 of 120, or a 24-point Expand composer action. Separate the action row with 8 points of padding.

top_issues.issue: The shortcut table has uneven key-to-description spacing.
top_issues.evidence: Left keycaps begin at x198 and descriptions at x389, a 191-pixel column interval. Right keycaps start at x682 and descriptions at x776, a 94-pixel interval. Short left shortcuts have a conspicuous empty gap.
top_issues.fix: Use a consistent key column width of about 160 points on both sides, with a 16-point gutter, or align each description 16 points after its key group.
